BlueDog3Desc: [B58CFF]Choose your dog.[-] Open Crafting and use this item in a dog companion recipe. Pick the breed you want, then place the crafted dog item in the world.
WorkbenchGasStove001_FRDesc: [B58CFF]Cooking station.[-] Place the stove and interact with it to see its recipes. Add the tools, ingredients and fuel required by your chosen recipe.
WorkbenchIronOven001_FRDesc: [B58CFF]Cooking station.[-] Place the oven and interact with it to see its recipes. Check the recipe's requirements before gathering ingredients.
WorkbenchMortarPestle001_FRDesc: [B58CFF]Ingredient preparation station.[-] Place it and interact with it to see what you can prepare. Add the ingredients listed by your chosen recipe.
rebirthFoodPickledVegetablesDesc: [B58CFF]Prepared vegetables.[-] Eat to add food and water to your digestive system. Nutrition and Hydration recover as the food is digested, rather than immediately.
ItemsWeaponsCleaver001_FRDesc: [B58CFF]Knives weapon.[-] A close-range blade. Effective hits give Knives practice. Watch your stamina when using power attacks.
ItemsWeaponsCrowbar001_FRDesc: [B58CFF]Clubs weapon.[-] A metal crowbar used as a blunt weapon. Effective hits give Clubs practice. Watch your stamina when using power attacks.
ItemsWeaponsJunkBaton001_FRDesc: [B58CFF]Batons weapon.[-] An improvised baton for close-range fighting. Effective hits give Batons practice. Watch your stamina when using power attacks.
ItemsWeaponsScythe004_FRDesc: [B58CFF]Scythes weapon.[-] Effective hits give Scythes practice. Leave room to move and watch your stamina when using power attacks.
HotwireKitDesc: [B58CFF]Start a repaired vehicle.[-] Used by the vehicle restoration system when hotwiring. The kit is consumed. Repair the vehicle's required parts first.
rebirthElectricalFuseDesc: [B58CFF]Electrical service part.[-] Used when servicing generators and battery banks. Keep it with your electrical supplies.
rebirthElectricalTerminalBlockDesc: [B58CFF]Electrical service part.[-] Used when servicing battery banks and electrical controls.
rebirthElectricalWiringHarnessDesc: [B58CFF]Generator service part.[-] Used together with an Electrical Fuse when servicing a generator.
rebirthReinforcedStrapsDesc: [B58CFF]Equipment crafting material.[-] Used to make expanded backpacks and the Hot Weather Shell. It does not add inventory space by itself.
rebirthPaddedLiningDesc: [B58CFF]Equipment crafting material.[-] Used to make expanded backpacks and the Cold Weather Lining. It does not add inventory space by itself.
FuriousRamsayModFireResistDesc: [B58CFF]Dog protection module.[-] Keep this in your dog's inventory to protect the dog from burning effects. Removing it removes the protection.
FuriousRamsayModShockResistDesc: [B58CFF]Dog protection module.[-] Keep this in your dog's inventory for protection against electrical damage and shock effects. Removing it removes the protection.
FuriousRamsayModSmokeResistDesc: [B58CFF]Dog protection module.[-] Keep this in your dog's inventory for protection against heat damage. Removing it removes the protection.
FuriousRamsayModFireShockResistDesc: [B58CFF]Dog protection module.[-] Keep this in your dog's inventory for protection against burning effects, electrical damage and shock effects. Removing it removes the protection.
FuriousRamsayModFireShockSmokeResistDesc: [B58CFF]Dog protection module.[-] Keep this in your dog's inventory for protection against burning effects, electrical damage, shock effects and heat damage. Removing it removes the protection.

palletBrownBoxesBaseOpenDesc: [B58CFF]Recoverable pallet.[-] Pick it up to obtain a reusable storage pallet.
